guide-entry-5810794e67291dba6e515dbe.description: Possibility of establishing an international judicial organ having competence in criminal matters. Desirability and the pros and cons of an international criminal jurisdiction. An international judicial organ as envisaged in the General Assembly resolution would be desirable only if effective. As the organ would be defective and therefore ineffective, concluded that its establishment was not desirable. Report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. A.E.F. Sandström ( 2nd session of ILC (1950)) A/CN.4/20 (in Yearbook, 1950, vol. II ) ILC Report, A/1316 (A/5/12), 1950, part IV, paras. 131–134
